domain_specific_rationale: CP-019 incorporates attempt_index (integer >= 1, default 1) into provider-request.schema.json. From a security and cryptographic integrity perspective, attempt_index provides the essential entropy input required for deterministic, non-colliding provider-side idempotency keys (e.g. SHA256 hashing of job_id and attempt_index). This guarantees protection against duplicate submission replays, double-billing exploits, and desynchronization between Core lease tracking and provider downstream tasks. It also facilitates precise audit logging and non-repudiation of individual generation attempts.
capability_impact: Directly supports CAP-03 (Provider Abstraction), CAP-07 (Security & Isolation), and CAP-12 (Autonomous Error Recovery) by ensuring cryptographically sound retry scoping and replay safety.
residual_risk: Improper monotonic counter progression by upstream orchestrators could result in idempotency collisions. Mitigation: R02 Core State and R06 Workflow engines must strictly increment attempt_index when issuing renewed leases or handling recoverable transient failures.
